name: Recoil Control Switchboard
description: Quickly enable or disable built-in recoil control.
author: Tavros Baker
code: const remove=xlinkWorkshop.addCheat("Recoil Control Switchboard","Quickly enable or disable built-in recoil control.",async()=>{const choice=prompt('Enter on or off for Recoil Control Switchboard','on');if(!choice)return;if(!['on','off'].includes(choice.toLowerCase()))throw Error('Choose on or off');await xlink.command("cheat recoil"+' '+choice.toLowerCase())});return remove;
